options.t: Acidity or burning in the stomach
Trouble breathing, chest pain, fainting, or swollen face/throat

fever1.q: How long have you had the fever?

fever3.q: Any of these: stiff neck, rash, confusion, severe headache, or very high fever?

cold1.q: Any wheezing, trouble breathing, or swelling of lips or face?

acid1.q: Any chest pain, black stools, vomiting blood, or severe pain?

acid2.q: Have the symptoms lasted more than 2 weeks?

loose1.q: Any of these: very dry mouth, no urine for 8 hours, confusion, or blood in stool?

cut1.q: Is the bleeding heavy, or not stopping after 10 minutes of pressure?

r_para.title: Suggested: Paracetamol
r_para.text: Follow the leaflet dose and never exceed the daily maximum. See a doctor if the fever lasts 3 days or more.

r_ceti.title: Suggested: Cetirizine
r_ceti.text: May cause drowsiness. If lips, face or throat swell, or breathing is hard, call 108 at once.

r_antacid.title: Suggested: Antacid
r_antacid.text: See a doctor if symptoms return often or last more than 2 weeks.

r_ors.title: Suggested: ORS
r_ors.text: Mix with clean water exactly as printed on the sachet and sip often.

r_antiseptic.title: Suggested: Antiseptic
r_antiseptic.text: Clean the wound, apply as per the label. External use only.

r_child.title: Please talk to a doctor
r_child.text: Medicine doses for children depend on weight and age. This machine does not guide children's doses.

r_doctor.title: Please see a doctor
r_doctor.text: These answers need a doctor's assessment. Visit a clinic or hospital.

r_emerg.title: This may be an emergency
r_emerg.text: Call 108 or 112 now. Do not self-medicate. You can also request doctor-approved emergency medicine below.
